title: About
tagline: Money, everyday life and health in one place — on your own device.
dataIntro: LifeSort collects sensitive things: what you earn, what you are treated for, what you are planning. Here is what the app does with them.

onDevice.title: Stored on your device first
onDevice.body: Everything you write is saved locally right away. The app works without a connection, and you never wait on a server.

backup.title: Backed up to your account
backup.body: When you are online, your data is sent on to your account so it follows you to a new device. You can check the status under Settings.

keychain.title: Login kept in the device keychain
keychain.body: Your login tokens live in the device's encrypted keychain — not in the app folder — and are shared with neither iCloud nor a new device.

appSwitcher.title: Hidden in the app switcher
appSwitcher.body: The screen is covered the moment the app leaves the foreground, so the app switcher preview never reveals what you were last looking at.

appLock.title: App lock, if you want it
appLock.body: You can turn on a PIN or biometric lock so the app asks for approval when opened. It is off by default.

settingsLinkBody: Turn on the app lock, change language or check your backup.
